decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension and out uilding is used.

Condition : 4 - The extension  and outbuilding] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 8 St Leonard's Gardens.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north and south walls of the extensions and outbuildings  hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house known as No.8 St Leonard's Gardens and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room separate dwelling or for business purposes).
description: Erection of a single storey front entrance and single storey side extension and the erection of a single storey detached garden shed in the rear end of the garden.
